payload.description: Run-stream envelope as an opaque JSON string

ResearchRunView.description: Shape of a research run listing: FULL pages full run rows; SUMMARY returns compact rows for polling

ResolvedHandle.description: Canonical subject a universal-lookup token resolved to. Exactly one of owner.entityId / owner.personId is set. Echoes the subject's canonical public handle and slug. Fetch display fields with GET /v1/entities/{entityId} or GET /v1/people/{personId}.

matchedBy.description: Which identifier kind matched the token.

owner.description: Canonical entity/person owner matched by the token.

publicId.description: Canonical stable public handle of the resolved subject; null on rows still awaiting handle backfill.

slug.description: Canonical slug of the resolved subject.

SearchLayer.description: Optional answer layer for a natural-language entity search. `passage` adds the text passages, from public research snippets and linked news, that best answer the question about the subject entities, their peers, or the top results; `synthesis` adds a written answer grounded only in those records and passages, citing each, and implies `passage`. A competitor, market, or provider question ("who competes with X", "top X companies", "who provides X") is always ranked by the judged probability that each entity answers it, so `judgment` adds nothing beyond that; `web` adds web search evidence, and the companies those results name, before judging. Other questions ignore `judgment` and `web`.

FederatedNaturalSearch.description: Plain-English search across companies, people, and news, plus optional per-scope entity constraints and page sizes.

answerModel.description: Optional supported model for the written answer, which also supplies the page heading, title, and description. Omit it to use the default; an unsupported model answers 422.

cacheMode.description: Cache policy. use reuses earlier search work; bypass and refresh compute fresh results and are honored only for accounts with private-data access.

entityFilter.description: Explicit entity constraints for the entity scope only, as on POST /v1/search/natural/entities: caller-supplied fields override planner values. The person and news scopes ignore it. Omitted defaults suppress non-operating entities, matching the aventure.vc search page; natural entity search is unchanged.

mode.description: Search strategy to run. Defaults to `auto`: the fast name layer runs first (a single-token query as keyword search, a multiword query as an exact normalized name) and the language-model planner runs only on a miss, so name lookups never pay for planning. Any other value forces exactly that strategy: `exact` and `keyword` skip planner model resolution and its rate limit. Entity and person natural-search take every value but `hybrid`; news and federated search accept only `auto` and `keyword`; content search accepts `auto`, `keyword`, `semantic`, and `hybrid` (`semantic` and `hybrid` only for one entity's or person's content).

model.description: Optional supported model for planning the search. Omit it to use the default; an unsupported model answers 422.

modelCatalogRevision.description: Model catalog revision this search uses for its model defaults and inference policy; null reads the current revision. Callers without private-data access always read the current revision. An unknown revision returns 404.

newsSize.description: News scope page size; defaults to 4, matching the aventure.vc search page, under the same page-size cap. Explicit null uses the size query parameter.

personSize.description: Person scope page size; defaults to 10, matching the aventure.vc search page, under the same page-size cap. Explicit null uses the size query parameter.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning effort for every model call this search makes: the query planner and the synthesis answer. Each call sends the nearest level its model supports, the lower one on a tie. Accounts without private-data access are capped at `medium`; higher values are lowered.

searchCatalogRevision.description: Search catalog revision this search uses for its global search policy and vocabulary; null reads the current revision. Callers without private-data access always read the current revision. An unknown revision returns 404.

sourceNewsId.description: News article whose public entity mentions join the entity candidates and are judged with them against the question

tenantPolicyRevision.description: Runtime policy revision this search uses for the serving deployment's execution budgets; null reads that deployment's current revision. Callers without private-data access always read the current revision. An unknown revision returns 404.

FederatedSearch.description: Federated entity, person, and news search result composed from each domain's canonical search result owner, with the strategy used for every scope.

entityDetail.description: Public detail for Product/Service rows on the entity result page, in search rank order. Other entity types are not hydrated.

news.description: Canonical news page returned by the keyword list engine.

newsEntityMention.description: Public entities each news row on the page links to, in news page order; a row with no public entity link has no entry.

personDetail.description: Public detail for people on the person result page, in search rank order, with at most two public entity associations per person; person address and URL enrichment is omitted.

personLead.description: Whether people lead this page: the query names a person, a web-found person's profile shows, or the query asks for people by a search catalog people term.

provenance.description: Requested and executed strategy for each search scope.

qualifier.description: A prompt with rewritten queries offered beside a broad query's results, from the search catalog revision the search read; null when no qualifier rule matches.

section.description: Result sections from most to least relevant. People lead when `personLead` is true and come last otherwise. Companies, products and services, and investors follow the rank of each section's best entity row, so a name whose best match is an investment firm leads with investors; sections with no entity row follow in that same fixed order.

items.description: Result section a search page renders: people; companies (operating companies, business lines, nonprofits, and governments); products and services; or investors (investment firms and funds).

LinkSearch.description: Search results related to a shared article or page URL: the fetched URL, the search query synthesized from the page content, and the federated entity, person, and news results for that query.

query.description: Search query synthesized from the page content.

related.description: Federated entity, person, and news results for the synthesized query.

url.description: The fetched page URL after validation.

EntityNaturalSearch.description: Plain-English entity search plus explicit hard constraints. The planner may fill only filter fields the caller leaves unset.

filter.description: Explicit entity constraints. Caller-supplied fields override planner values; the planner fills only fields left at their canonical defaults.

search.description: Canonical plain-English search request and strategy.

sourceNewsId.description: News article whose public entity mentions join the entity candidates and are judged with them against the question

NaturalSearchResult.description: Natural-language entity search result: planner interpretation plus the canonical entity list page produced by EntityListService.

answer.description: Written answer grounded in the subject, peer, and result records and the passages; null unless the request asks for the `synthesis` layer.

filing.description: Discovered companies this caller filed and their research runs.

interpretation.description: Structured interpretation used to run the entity list query.

investment.description: Recorded investment participation supporting investor discovery. Each row keeps its entity or personal investor, portfolio company, transaction attribution, and query-matched offering evidence. Empty for other question intents.

judgment.description: Judged rows of the `result` page for a competitor, market, or provider question: the same entities in the same order, each with its judged probability. Empty for other questions.

passage.description: Passages that best answer the question, ranked by score; empty unless the request asks for the `passage` layer.

peer.description: Curated competitors of the single subject entity for `peer` questions; semantic look-alikes are the result page. Empty otherwise.

pendingWebQuery.description: Web searches for this question not yet stored; their evidence joins a later request. Empty without the `web` layer.

personLead.description: Whether people lead this search, stamped only on entity stream events.

result.description: Entity list page returned by the canonical entity list engine.

searchRequestId.description: Id of this search's stored record. Null when the search was not recorded.

subject.description: Entities the question is about, one per resolved subject name, in query order; empty when the question names none or none resolves.

PersonNaturalSearch.description: Plain-English people search plus explicit hard constraints. The planner may fill only filter fields the caller leaves unset.

filter.description: Explicit people constraints. Caller-supplied fields override planner values; the planner fills only fields left at their canonical defaults.

search.description: Canonical plain-English search request and strategy.

PersonNaturalSearchResult.description: Natural-language people search result: planner interpretation plus the canonical person page produced by the person list engine.

interpretation.description: Structured interpretation used to run the people query.

investment.description: Personal investment participation supporting the returned people. Firm portfolio activity is never attributed to employees. Empty for other question intents.

personLead.description: Whether people are the confirmed requested focus of this search.

profile.description: aVenture people resolved or filed from web-discovered LinkedIn profiles whom no returned person matches, grouped by `named` in query order. A search that has not run yet runs only for a signed-in subscriber with `layer=web`.

result.description: Person page returned by the canonical person list engine.

searchRequestId.description: Id of this search's stored record. Null when the search was not recorded.

SharedSearchMutation.description: Publish a query under a stable client UUID; retries return the same saved answer.

id.description: Stable sharing UUID generated once and reused across retries.

query.description: Plain-English query to run against public records and publish.

searchRequestId.description: entity.searchRequestId of the federated search response the sharing page showed. When that search was signed in, asked this query (ignoring case), and its shareable answer is still kept, the share publishes exactly that answer without searching again; otherwise it runs the default public search.

SharedSearch.description: A saved public search query and answer.

canonicalSlug.description: Slug of the canonical share of the same query, compared case-insensitively: the share named by the query's own slug, else the earliest share. Pages name it as their canonical URL; equals publication.slug on that share.

UniqueIdTypeAlias.description: Canonical uniqueId type value plus its label, accepted aliases, owner scope, and format pattern.

alias.description: Alias tokens accepted by the write boundary.

canonical.description: Canonical uniqueId type value persisted in id_type.

ownerScope.description: Owner kinds this identifier type may attach to.

pattern.description: Regex the identifier value must match, when constrained.

UrlTypeAlias.description: Canonical urlType value plus accepted alias and platform host tokens.

hostDomain.description: Host domains used by URL inference for this urlType.

Search.description: Live web search request with cache controls

allowSuspectedShellStrip.description: Set true only when an unmarked amount in the search text is intentional.

bypassCache.description: Skip cache lookup and refresh from the search provider

cacheKey.description: Stable lookup text for cache keying when generated search text varies between runs

deep.description: Deprecated alias for `provider: EXA_DEEP`; `true` with any other `provider` is refused with 400.

deferredAiOverview.description: Wait in-request for Google's AI Overview when Google defers it to a follow-up request, as it does for most company and person lookups: one extra SerpAPI search per overview not already stored. An explicit `true` also reruns a stored search older than SerpAPI's one-hour cache to get a fresh token (its one-minute overview token expired and the cache would return it unchanged). Without it, no deferred overview is fetched; one an earlier fetch stored still comes back at no extra cost. A fetch that returns no overview is not retried for six hours. An overview Google returns inline always comes back in `aiOverview` at no extra cost. Exa results never carry one.

provider.description: Provider to search; omitted keeps the default, SerpAPI. EXA runs Exa's instant search with highlights and never falls back to SerpAPI: an Exa failure answers 503. EXA_DEEP runs Exa's slower, broader deep search (higher recall for market and provider questions, about 3-6 s) and falls back to SerpAPI on an Exa failure. Both Exa providers answer synchronously (`Prefer: respond-async` does not apply), are stored apart from SerpAPI results, and are charged like any search.

recency.description: Return only results Google dates within this window; BRIGHT_DATA only, refused with 400 for other providers. Omitted searches every date.

SearchOrderingPersonSortField.description: Ordering applied to a search result page: an optional relevance rank that precedes the sortable-column terms.

SortOrderPersonSortField.description: Single sort term: which enumerated sort field to use and whether direction is descending.

field.description: Sort field for this resource (entity list uses EntityFilter.Sortable / published sort keys).

sortKey.description: Request sort key for this field: pass `sort=<sortKey>,<asc|desc>` to the matching directory list endpoint to reproduce this term. Absent when the field has no request key.

SearchRelevance.description: Relevance rank that ordered a search page before any sortable column.

SearchMode.description: Search strategy for a natural-language search request. `auto` keeps the server pipeline (exact-name shortcut first, planner otherwise); `exact` matches entity or person names exactly with no planner and no embedding; `keyword` runs full-text search; `semantic` runs vector similarity; `natural` always runs the language-model planner; `hybrid` fuses keyword and semantic rankings by reciprocal rank. Entity and person natural-search support every mode but `hybrid`; news and federated search accept only `auto` and `keyword`; content search accepts `auto` (topic, type, relation, and year words become filters and any other words rank by full text), `keyword` (the full text of articles, posts, and fetched pages), `semantic` (one entity's or person's library pages by vector similarity of their fetched bodies), and `hybrid` (that owner's keyword and semantic rankings fused; each ranking is cut at the largest page size, so a hybrid search returns at most twice that many items, and it orders by fused rank only, ignoring `sort`).

SearchAnswer.description: Written answer to a natural-language question, grounded only in the response's entity records and passages. LOW confidence with no paragraph means the evidence does not answer the question.

citation.description: Evidence the paragraphs cite, in first-use order.

confidence.description: How fully the cited evidence answers the question.

description.description: One- or two-sentence summary of at most 155 characters for a search-result snippet; absent when the answer abstains.

heading.description: The question as the answer page's heading: the asker's own words in title case, with record names in their stored casing; it never adds, drops, or corrects a word. Absent when the answer abstains.

paragraph.description: The answer's paragraphs in reading order, each citing the evidence it rests on; empty when the answer abstains. A first paragraph without `topic` is the lead, written as a standalone answer of one or two sentences that reads complete when shown alone; later paragraphs expand it by topic without restating it.

relatedQuery.description: Up to five follow-up searches grounded in the cited evidence; empty when the answer abstains.

shareable.description: True when the answer has grounded paragraphs and the answer model did not judge the question advertising or promotion; only a shareable answer can be published as a public search page.

text.description: Every paragraph's text in reading order, separated by blank lines; read `paragraph` to place each citation beside the text it supports.

title.description: Page title of at most 60 characters naming the answer's subject, then the angle and scope its paragraphs cover, written by the same model call; pages show it as the subheading under `heading`. Absent when the answer abstains.

matchedOffering.description: Current public Product/Service that supports this answer.

probability.description: Judged probability, 0 to 1, that the entity answers the question.

EntityList.description:
Narrow entity row for list and batch-list reads. Keeps core identity, enrichment,
        governed research detail, accelerator participation, and fundraise rounds while omitting
        detail-only relationship, newsArticle, person, sitemap, and research snippet sections.
         Classification enrichment is current-only on list rows; use the entity classifications
         subresource with includeInactive=true to audit historical joins.
         Addresses are bounded current-location samples, not a complete office inventory;
         use the entity addresses subresource to list every office and association.

core.description: Flat entity core — identity, naming, status, image, and source metadata

enrichment.description: Supplemental entity data — addresses, classification tags, funding, text content, and URL links

fundraiseRound.description: Fundraise rounds associated with this entity

provider.description: Fund manager firm or product/service provider; null otherwise.

research.description: List-safe research disclosure without text snippets

semanticMatch.description: Semantic embedding match evidence populated only for semantic list reads.

Entity.description: Flat entity core record — identity, naming, status, image, and source metadata. An entity is our umbrella record for organizations such as companies, funds, investment firms and investors, accelerators, nonprofits, and government agencies, plus products and services connected to those organizations. Nested as .core inside EntityList for default list reads and EntityDetail for detail reads.

lastModifiedAt.description: Provenance-grounded last-modified watermark (schema.org dateModified). Advances only when a real, consumer-meaningful data point changes via a recorded provenance event — never on timestamp-only writes, migrations, or index refreshes. Pairs with createdAt (dateCreated) and grounds the sitemap lastmod.

nameAlias.description: All names this entity has been known by — current alternates, DBAs, former names, and rebrand-source identities. Naming history (e.g. `Metaphor Systems` for the current `Exa` entity) lives here; never as a separate relationship type or `formerName` field.

operatingStatus.description: Current operating status. Use Acquired Subsidiary when the entity was acquired and still operates; use Closed (Acquihire) when the entity was acquired for its team and shut down, rendering like Closed everywhere; use Acquired only when it is terminal, folded, or closed.

publicId.description: Stable, immutable public handle (e.g. `eV1StGXR8Z5a`). Never changes once assigned, unlike the slug. Null on projections that do not select it and on rows still awaiting handle backfill.

publicUrl.description: Absolute public profile URL on the aVenture front-end, e.g. `https://aventure.vc/non-profits/{slug}`, derived from the typeRecord's canonical route family. Null when the route needs relationship context or the record has no direct public SSR route (Business Line, Organization, Product, Service, or a non-public slug). EntityDetail.publicUrl resolves Business Line parent context. A Product/Service has no standalone page: it is addressed only as `{providerPublicUrl}/products-services/{slug}` under its provider, because its slug is unique only per provider; the sitemap-urls slot paths already emit those child routes.

sitemap.description: Sub-route eligibility, populated by the sitemap projection. Null on non-sitemap reads to keep thin payloads compact.

EntityEnrichment.description: Supplemental entity data — addresses, classification tags, funding, text content, and URL links

address.description: Current addresses. List rows carry bounded current locations for named roles, identification evidence, and card display, not every office or association history. Single-detail reads retain all current locations and their association history. Full-detail search carries only the headquarters row (headquartersAddressId); GET /v1/entities/{entityId}/addresses lists every row.

classification.description: Entity classifications. Single-detail and full-detail batch reads include history; list, default batch, and similar-entity reads may return only current classifications. Use GET /v1/entities/{entityId}/classifications?includeInactive=true for the full history.

fundingDetail.description: Funding aggregate: enrichment.fundingDetail.totalRaisedUsd is the USD sum of recorded round amounts with available FX rates, not a complete lifetime total when round amounts or rates are missing.

headquartersAddressId.description: Operating headquarters address id: match enrichment.headquartersAddressId to enrichment.address[].id. Absent when no current dominant (operating) address is on record, even when a domicile (legal seat) exists. Deprecated isHq marks the legal seat, not the operating HQ.

headquartersRemoteAsOf.description: When aVenture last verified that this entity runs no operating headquarters (a remote company); absent while a current operating headquarters is on record or no unexpired verification exists.

publicControllingParentId.description: Unique publicly readable current primary controlling parent with current Public eligibility, for a Business Line only; null when not proven. Derived from the current parent or acquirer relationship, never a listing or Public ownership claim on this entity.

EntityProfileStatus.description: Read-only profile status derived from stored kind, ownership, operating status, and a Business Line's proven public controlling parent. Funding stage stays on enrichment.fundingDetail.stage.

isAcquired.description: Operating status records an acquisition; null when no status is established.

isClosed.description: Stopped operating with no surviving business; null when no status is established.

isTerminal.description: Operating status is terminal; null when no status is established.

The current entity a fund or product/service is offered by: a fund's manager organization, a
        product/service's provider, through its current primary edge to a live, listed provider.
        Null on every other entity type.

entity.description: Provider core. Its image is the provider's own logo, else the logo of the provider's current parent entity.

accelerator.description: Canonical thin accelerator entity from the acceleratorParticipant relationship

acceleratorName.description: Full accelerator participation name, including program detail

asOfDate.description: Source-stated participation effective date or instant

program.description: Accelerator program name, when the source distinguishes one

EntityProfileHeadline.description: Profile headline derived from record kind, current market-standing ownership (Public or Private only), a Business Line's proven public controlling parent, and operating status. Never a funding stage. Render an unrecognized value verbatim.

EntityFundingDetail.description: Aggregate view of an entity's fundraising activity

applicability.description: RECORDED when an eligible financing amount, including an explicit zero, exists. Otherwise UNKNOWN for a company, investment firm, or unestablished kind; NOT_APPLICABLE for a fund, nonprofit, government, business line, product, or service with no recorded financing amount. Recorded financing history is preserved for every kind. Null or absent means this contract was not supplied, not that financing is unknown. totalRaised retains its legacy numeric type.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of totalRaised, latestValuation, and mostRecentAmount: the one currency every round uses, else the entity's own currency when rounds carry none. Null when rounds use more than one currency or no fundraise rollup exists, so these amounts have no single currency.

currentValuation.description: Selected eligible valuation with its own currency/basis/date, including standalone research evidence. Optional on older servers; absence is not zero.

disclosedStage.description: Latest explicitly recorded equity ladder label retained in a transaction's source round field, not calculatedRoundLabel or a Late Stage Private inference. Null when no canonical disclosed ladder label is recorded; does not assert market standing.

disclosedStageTransactionId.description: Transaction retaining disclosedStage; read its history/source, not a current listing assertion.

fundingRoundCount.description: Recorded round count, including rounds with no recorded amount.

latestValuation.description: Legacy latest-transaction valuation; not a current observation or USD value. Use currentValuation.

totalRaised.description: Sum of recorded round amounts in their original currencies, excluding rounds with no amount; not a complete lifetime total when amounts are missing. Use totalRaisedUsd for a USD aggregate; totalRaised has no single currency when currency is null. Legacy numeric projection: zero also represents unknown or inapplicable financing; read applicability before displaying it. This field remains numeric until all supported readers accept nullable totals.

totalRaisedAmountRoundCount.description: Eligible totalRaisedUsd rounds with a recorded amount, including an explicit zero. Subtract from totalRaisedRoundCount for undisclosed amounts. Null means unknown coverage.

totalRaisedRoundCount.description: Deduplicated rounds eligible for totalRaisedUsd, including undisclosed amounts. Uses exactly that total's acquisition/bankruptcy exclusions; unlike fundingRoundCount, this is the coverage denominator. Null until coverage is available.

totalRaisedUsd.description: USD aggregate at enrichment.fundingDetail.totalRaisedUsd: sums only recorded round amounts with an announcement-date ECB/World Bank rate. Excludes rounds with no amount or no rate, so do not report it as a complete lifetime total when either is missing. Null when no eligible amount converts or coverage is not available; a converted recorded zero remains zero. Use totalRaisedRoundCount, totalRaisedAmountRoundCount and totalRaisedUsdRoundCount for coverage of this same deduplicated eligible set, never fundingRoundCount as its denominator.

totalRaisedUsdRoundCount.description: Eligible totalRaisedUsd rounds whose recorded amount has a USD conversion, including converted zero. Subtract from totalRaisedAmountRoundCount for missing FX. Null means unknown coverage; zero means no converted amount is known.

unconvertedRoundCount.description: Rounds with an amount but no announcement-date USD rate, excluded from totalRaisedUsd. Does not count rounds with no recorded amount; zero does not prove the total is complete.

FundingApplicability.description: Whether financing amounts are recorded, unknown, or inapplicable.

EntityValuation.description: Current eligible valuation with its own amount, basis, currency and source date.

amount.description: Native source amount as a plain decimal JSON string, preserving stored precision without JSON-number rounding or Long truncation.

asOfDate.description: Source-effective year, month, day or timestamp; null when the observation is undated.

basis.description: Source-stated basis; null when legacy evidence did not state one. Reported is not silently post-money.

currency.description: The observation's own ISO currency. Null means unknown, never the entity currency or USD.

postMoneyUsd.description: Post-money amount in USD as a plain decimal JSON string under the existing ECB/World Bank conversion policy; derived only from same-source pre-money plus raised when needed; null for pre-money-only without raised, unknown currency, or unavailable foreign-currency date/rate. Never substitutes an older observation.

referenceValue.description: Original research qualifier, retained without interpreting a fiscal/forecast period as currency.

FundingStage.description: Funding stage only, emitted by the entity fundraise rollup. The record headline is profileStatus.headline; the entity-type and operating-status members are deprecated as a headline and retire in a later contract change. Transaction classifications such as Debt, IPO, and Acquisition are not entity stages.

ValuationType.description: Which side of the pre/post relationship the source declared.

EntityValuationSource.description: Which canonical store the point came from.

EntityImage.description: Grouped entity image fields for square, standard, and monogram logo state

logoSquareVariant.description: Verified variants of logoSquare's exact final master path; null means unknown, an empty array means known-empty. Use the master when absent or empty.

logoVariant.description: Verified variants of logo's exact final master path; null means unknown, an empty array means known-empty. Use the master when absent or empty.

EntityNameAliasEntityAliasType.description: Alternate name used for search and display

displayable.description: Show this alias in public name displays.

EntitySitemap.description: Sub-route eligibility GATE for sitemap.xml emission, not a write receipt. Each boolean is true only when the underlying rows EXIST AND every entity that sub-route renders (this entity and any counterpart, e.g. the acquired/acquirer company behind `hasAcquisitions`) currently passes publication visibility (not hidden, on sitemap). A `false` flag when you know the data exists means an unmet visibility prerequisite -- publish the hidden entity -- confirmed against the owning command-side read; it is an active gate result, not refresh lag, and a flag being `false` says nothing succeeded-and-is-fine. Served from a materialized projection (`mv_entity_sitemap_url_slots`) refreshed asynchronously, so a `true` flag can trail a gate that was just satisfied, but a successful write alone does not flip any flag.

hasAcquisitions.description: Whether `/companies/<slug>/acquisitions` should be emitted. True only when an acquisition relationship exists AND both the acquired and acquirer entities are publicly visible. A confirmed acquisition relationship row with this flag `false` (or with `entities acquisitions list` returning zero rows) means a counterpart entity is still hidden -- publish it -- it is a visibility gate, not list lag.

hasAnalysis.description: Whether the profile Analysis sub-route should be emitted.

hasEmployees.description: Whether the profile Employees sub-route should be emitted.

hasFundraising.description: Whether the profile Fundraising sub-route should be emitted.

hasNews.description: Whether the profile News sub-route should be emitted.

productServiceSlug.description: Slugs of related Product/Service entities that should each get their own `/companies/<slug>/products-services/<productSlug>` URL, capped at `MAX_PRODUCT_SERVICE_SLUGS` server-side. Derived from current `productService` relationships in either stored direction; the entity relationships resource is the authoritative, read-your-writes view of those joins.

EntitySimilarityContext.description: Per-row provenance for a similar-entity result

compositeScore.description: Composite (section-fusion) score. Populated only when origin=precomputed.

curatedAsOf.description: Curated source-stated as-of date when origin=curated

derivedFromEntityId.description: Curated peer id that produced this row when origin=derived

matchedSectionWeight.description: Total normalized source-section weight matched when origin=precomputed

rank.description: 1-based position in the merged result page

sharedSectionCount.description: Number of source/target sections compared when origin=precomputed

SearchEvidenceSource.description: Owner of search evidence: `entityRecord` is the entity's structured record, `researchSnippet` an entity research snippet, `newsArticle` a news article linked to the entity; `personRecord` a person linked to the entity; `fundraiseTransaction` a recorded investment round with investor attribution; `webProfile` a web page on a site the entity owns.

SearchIntent.description: Question shape the planner read from a natural-language search. `discovery` lists entities matching a description; `profile` asks what a named entity does, offers, or how it stands; `peer` asks for a named entity's competitors or look-alikes; `comparison` asks how two or more named entities compare.

SearchOrderingEntityFilterSortable.description: Ordering applied to a search result page: an optional relevance rank that precedes the sortable-column terms.

order.description: Sortable-column terms applied after the relevance rank, highest precedence first. Empty when the relevance rank alone ordered the page. Listing priorities that every list page applies ahead of these terms, such as operating-status and logo priority, are not reported.

relevance.description: Relevance rank applied before any column term; absent when no relevance rank ran.

SortOrderEntityFilterSortable.description: Single sort term: which enumerated sort field to use and whether direction is descending.

descending.description: true for descending (DESC), false for ascending (ASC)

field.description: Sort field for this resource (entity list uses EntityFilter.Sortable / published sort keys).

sortKey.description: Request sort key for this field: pass `sort=<sortKey>,<asc|desc>` to the matching directory list endpoint to reproduce this term. Absent when the field has no request key.

SearchAnswerCitation.description: One piece of evidence an answer cites, by its owning record.

source.description: Record that owns the cited evidence.

sourceId.description: Entity id for `entityRecord`, snippet or news article id from `passage`, person id for `personRecord`, the recorded round id for `fundraiseTransaction`, or the page URL for `webProfile`.

SearchAnswerParagraph.description: One paragraph of an answer and the evidence it rests on.

citation.description: Evidence this paragraph rests on, most important first.

topic.description: Short label naming the category, market, or segment this paragraph covers, such as "Smartphones · North America"; absent on the lead paragraph.

webSource.description: Web pages this paragraph rests on that no aVenture record owns, such as an encyclopedia article about a company the directory lacks; most important first. Always sent; absent only from answers written before it existed.

SearchAnswerWebSource.description: A web search result an answer paragraph cites, by its page.

title.description: Title of the cited page as the search result named it.

url.description: Address of the cited page.

NewsEntityMention.description: Public entities one news article links to, in link order.

entity.description: Public entities the article links to.

FederatedSearchProvenance.description: Requested and executed search strategy for every federated scope.

answerUnavailable.description: True when synthesis was requested but the answer model was temporarily unavailable (an upstream outage, open circuit, full concurrency limit, or expired deadline), so the entity scope carries no answer while every scope's rows returned. Retrying the same query may succeed.

incompleteScope.description: Scopes whose optional sources did not all complete. Returned rows remain fully judged and usable but the population is incomplete, so this response must not be cached as final. Retrying the same query may complete these scopes.

items.description: Record type a federated search covers.

rejection.description: Scopes that rejected the query as unsearchable and returned an empty page while the other scopes ran; empty when every scope ran.

unavailable.description: Scopes whose search was temporarily unavailable (an upstream outage, open circuit, full concurrency limit, or expired deadline) and returned an empty page while the other scopes ran; empty when every scope ran. Retrying the same query may succeed, unlike a rejection.

items.description: Record type a federated search covers.

SearchQualifier.description: A prompt offered beside a broad query's results, with rewritten queries that narrow or widen it.

option.description: Rewritten queries the reader can run instead, in display order.

SearchQualifierOption.description: One rewritten query a qualifier offers.

FederatedSearchRejection.description: One federated scope that rejected the query instead of searching.

detail.description: Why the scope rejected the query.

field.description: Request field the scope rejected, such as search.

SearchCacheMode.description: Search-stage cache policy: use reuses completed and in-flight work; bypass computes independently without retaining search outputs; refresh computes independently and replaces the normal cache entry. Immutable query vectors and canonical record caches retain their own cache policy.

ReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level, lowest to highest: `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. A model receives the nearest level it supports.

instruction.description: Instruction for the tool within the conversation turn character limit

sectionKey.description: Exact snippet catalog typeValue; required for RENDER_SECTION

EntityResearchPublicSource.description: Published page behind a research value, read from the provenance event that wrote the value. Absent for internal sources, privacy, terms, or other legal pages, and, in public views, suppressed secondary sources such as data aggregators.

lastFetchedAt.description: When aVenture last fetched this page; absent when no stored capture of it exists.

publishedAt.description: When the page was published, from aVenture's news record for the same URL; absent when the page is not a known news article.

recordedAt.description: When aVenture recorded the value from this page.

sourceDetail.description: URL of the published page supporting the value.

EntityAnalysisCitation.description: Verbatim evidence from an archived source document.

quote.description: Nonempty verbatim quote to verify against the archived document.

EntityAnalysisFigure.description: One figure illustrating its section; every cell is a verbatim excerpt of a section quote.

column.description: COMPARISON column headings (1-4, each 1-48 characters), one per cell in every entry; empty otherwise.

entry.description: Entries in display order: 2-8, or 1-8 for METRIC.

title.description: Caption stating what the figure shows.

type.description: Layout that decides how entries and columns render.

EntityAnalysisSectionOrigin.description: Author of a draft section: the run's agent or its signed-in owner.

label.description: Catalog analysisSectionLabel at this position; null for ordinary prose.

text.description: One nonempty paragraph without embedded line breaks.

WriterBrief.description: Finished research analysis for a governed prose write. The writer may phrase only the selected output claims and supplied judgments.

claim.description: Complete evidence ledger with source page and verbatim quote.

metaAnalysis.description: Finished research question, answer, framework judgments, gaps, and change signals.

outputClaim.description: Evidence claims this output states: paragraph.claim in paragraph order. Derived by the server; a sent value is ignored.

paragraph.description: Paragraph plan; each paragraph states the listed claims and judgments, and paragraph order is the output order; only the first paragraph consumes the answer.

positioning.description: Positioning decisions selected by research. Put each decision and all its cited claims in one paragraph. A listed decision stays in that paragraph; an unlisted decision goes to the paragraph of its first cited claim.

ResearchFinding.description: One fact you researched, with the page and exact text that support it. The run checks the quote against the page before it writes the fact.

end.description: Exclusive UTF-16 end offset, as an entity folio fact's end.

gateId.description: Profile field the fact fills, when known; omit it and the run picks the field the fact belongs to.

quote.description: The exact text on sourceUrl that states the fact, copied verbatim; a fragment short enough to appear on any page is refused. Send either quote or the complete sourceDocumentId, start, end span, never both.

sourceDocumentId.description: Writer briefs only: the stored capture a span cites instead of a retyped quote, such as an entity folio fact's sourceDocumentId; the server copies the quote from [start, end) of that capture's evidence text. Requester findings require quote.

sourceUrl.description: Absolute http or https URL of the page that supports the fact; aVenture pages are refused. Direct writes require a resolved sourceDetail page and may supplement it with eligible pages associated with the subject or explicitly bound through sourceDocumentId on a pending full create; harness-run writes use the sourceDetail page or eligible pages read through aVenture by the authorizing run. Each quote must occur in its page's stored text.

start.description: Inclusive UTF-16 start offset, as an entity folio fact's start.

statement.description: The fact to write, in plain words. May be omitted for a complete sourceDocumentId, start, end span; the server uses that span's exact stored text as the statement.

writerSurface.description: Surface this sourced claim may enter: durable entity text, point-in-time research snippets, or both. New writer briefs must declare it.

WriterMetaAnalysis.description: Research judgment the writer must preserve.

answer.description: Overall answer to the research question.

asOfDate.description: Date through which the judgment is current.

changeSignal.description: Evidence that would change the supplied view.

gap.description: Known gaps or conflicts that must not become invented facts.

scope.description: Boundary and period used by the research.

section.description: Ordered framework judgments for a research snippet whose skill defines sections.

analysis.description: Meta-analysis judgments this paragraph must consume.

claim.description: Output claims this paragraph states, in order.

positioning.description: Positioning decisions this paragraph must consume; each declared decision at most once across paragraphs. Assign all claims cited by a decision to its paragraph. An unlisted decision goes to the paragraph of its first cited claim.

WriterPositioning.description: One positioning decision and supporting claims.

claim.description: Output claim numbers whose quotes support the decision; all cited claims must be assigned to its paragraph.

WriterPositioningElement.description: Research-selected category, buyer, approach, differentiation, or alternative.

WriterParagraphAnalysis.description: Meta-analysis judgments assigned to one paragraph.

answer.description: Whether this paragraph states the overall research answer; true on the first paragraph only.

section.description: Framework section labels this paragraph must state, in order.

claim.description: Evidence claim numbers supporting the judgment.

WriterChangeSignal.description: Evidence that would change the supplied judgment.

claim.description: Evidence claim numbers supporting the signal.

statement.description: Observable signal that would change the view.

WriterGap.description: A known evidence gap or conflict.

claim.description: Evidence claim numbers supporting the gap; cite at least one for a CONFLICTING gap, or use an empty list when nothing was found.

WriterScope.description: Research boundary used by a writer brief.

geography.description: Geography when the evidence is geographically bounded.

period.description: Research period when the evidence is time-bounded.

WriterGapReason.description: Reason a research gap remains unresolved.

WriterClaimSurface.description: Output surface selected for a sourced writer claim.

EntityAnalysisFigureEntry.description: One labeled entry of excerpt cells.

cell.description: One cell per COMPARISON column; exactly one cell for every other type.

label.description: Entry heading: the party (COMPARISON), the date as its quote states it (TIMELINE), the step (FLOW), or the measure and period (METRIC).

EntityAnalysisFigureType.description: Figure layout: COMPARISON matrix of parties by attribute, dated TIMELINE, ordered FLOW of steps, or METRIC key figures.

EntityAnalysisFigureCell.description: A verbatim excerpt of one section citation's quote.

citation.description: Position of the cited quote in the section's citation list, from 1.

excerpt.description: Exact text copied from that quote; the figure displays it as is.

EntityAnalysisSection.description: One unverified analysis section; replace it by its snippet type key.

citation.description: Stored source documents and verbatim evidence quotes; verification occurs before publication.

figure.description: At most two figures illustrating this section; each cell excerpts one of its quotes.

key.description: Exact typeValue from GET /v1/entities/research-snippets/types; also the section path key.

origin.description: Author of this edit; the server derives this from the authenticated caller.

paragraph.description: Paragraphs in catalog order, satisfying paragraphShape and analysisSectionLabel.

ProseProblem.description: Why a sentence or paragraph of entity text or a research snippet was rejected.

HarnessRunFollowUp.description: Durable completion barrier and direct child run ids

admission.description: PENDING until every follow-up admission is durable; REJECTED when the bounded redo is exhausted

hasMore.description: More than the bounded child count exists; completion is unproven

runId.description: Direct appointed run ids; read each run's detail recursively

HarnessRunProgress.description: Current public progress of a harness run

complete.description: Whether the enrichment loop reports completion

entitySlug.description: Canonical entity slug currently reported by the loop

gateRemaining.description: Profile sections the run has not finished yet

note.description: Optional progress note from the loop

whatElseRemaining.description: Additional work the loop reports as remaining

writeThisIteration.description: Writes completed during the current loop iteration

HarnessRunFollowUpAdmission.description: Durable admission state for one terminal run generation's follow-up work

AgentTaskPreset.description: A research preset: one named topic a research run can focus on.

execution.description: How the preset runs: FULL focuses a full research run on its topic; MICRO runs it as one bounded research task; INTERACTIVE runs a subscriber-selectable session that accepts no findings and stays open for user turns.

key.description: Stable key to send in taskPresetKey.

name.description: Display name of the topic the preset researches.

phase.description: Dispatch phase for intra-job ordering: PRIMARY presets run first; FINAL presets defer until the primary wave completes so they read the freshly-updated entity dossier.

AgentTaskPresetExecution.description: How a selected research preset runs: FULL runs the full enrichment loop; MICRO runs one bounded agent task; INTERACTIVE is a subscriber-selectable session preset whose run accepts no findings and stays open for user turns.

AgentTaskPresetPhase.description: Dispatch phase governing intra-job ordering when presets are multi-selected.

HarnessTaskInputBinding.description: One task input value bound before the run starts; the server validates its key and type.

entityId.description: Canonical entity UUID; exclusive with newsId, text, writerBrief and fact.

fact.description: One source-bound fact for a FACT input; exclusive with entityId, newsId, text and writerBrief.

key.description: Catalog input key; omit it to bind the task's only declared input of the value's type.

newsId.description: Canonical news id; exclusive with entityId, text, writerBrief and fact.

text.description: Literal requester text; exclusive with entityId, newsId, writerBrief and fact.

writerBrief.description: Typed writer brief for a WRITER_BRIEF input; exclusive with entityId, newsId, text and fact.

HarnessTaskFact.description: One source-bound fact the requester asks the task run to research.

eventDate.description: Date of the event, when known.

sourceUrl.description: Absolute http or https URL of the page supporting the fact.

statement.description: The single fact to research; non-blank and bounded by the task-input text limit.

PersonSimilarityResult.description: Similar person list row with the provenance that explains why it appears. Rows carry the canonical Person projection; load full detail through the person detail endpoints.

currentRole.description: Current titled association for the similar-person card; null when no current titled role is available.

PersonSimilarityContext.description: Per-row provenance for a similar-person result.

cosineScore.description: Cosine similarity score where higher is closer.

rank.description: 1-based position in the merged result page

PersonSimilarityOrigin.description: Provenance origin for a similar-person result row.

PersonInvestment.description: Domain model for a person's investment in an entity (fundraise transaction)

date.description: Announced date of the fundraise round. Use this field for when the investment happened; null when the round date is unknown.

investmentDate.description: When aVenture recorded this person's participation in the round. It is not the investment date: imported portfolios share their import date. Use date for when the round happened.

investorAttribution.description: Investor-specific attribution for this person's participation in the fundraise round. amountInvested is a plain decimal number in the fundraise transaction currency and is not added to amount.

PersonInvestedCompany.description: Company metadata associated with a person investment

headquartersCity.description: Headquarters city of the investee at read time, when known

headquartersCountry.description: Headquarters country of the investee, when known

headquartersRegion.description: Headquarters region (state or province) of the investee, when known

industry.description: Primary industry classification of the investee, when known

EntityFundraise.description: Fundraise transaction metadata linked to a person investment

dateAnnounced.description: Announced date of the fundraise round; null when unknown. Preserves the source's calendar or timestamp precision.

FundraiseInvestmentAttribution.description: Investor-specific attribution: an investor's investment in one round (its joins there, one per vehicle, summed) or, in source attribution, one investor join

amountInvested.description: Investor-level attributed amount invested in the fundraise transaction currency: the investor's joins on the round summed for an investment, or one join's amount in source attribution. Serialized as a plain JSON number such as 220000 or 123456.78; no currency sign, currency code, comma grouping, or abbreviated amount text is valid.

attributionType.description: How this attribution row participates in the investor view.

beneficialEntityId.description: Investment firm entity receiving the rollup attribution.

fundManagerRelationshipId.description: Fund-manager relationship id when the attribution rolls up through a managed fund.

joinId.description: Fundraise investor join identifier; for a summed investment, one of the joins it sums

leadInvestor.description: Recorded lead flag. Historical false values may mean non-lead or unrecorded leadership evidence; false alone is not confirmation of a non-lead role.

recordedEntityId.description: Entity recorded directly on the fundraise investor join.

round.description: Round label for the attributed participation

FundraiseInvestmentAttributionType.description: How a fundraise investor attribution row was selected for an investor view.

RoundLabel.description: Round participation label - shared by entity and person investor participation

PersonGraphCareerContext.description: Entity facts, recent news, colleagues, and similar entities for one associated entity

colleague.description: People associated with the same entity, excluding the subject person, ranked by currency and recency

employeeCount.description: Most recent employee-count research fact when one is recorded

entity.description: Entity card projection: core identity plus aggregate funding rollup

primaryAddress.description: Primary address of the entity when one is recorded

recentNews.description: Most recent news linked to the entity, newest first

similarEntity.description: Entities similar to this entity, from the entity similarity rails

PersonGraphCoInvestor.description: Person who co-invested with the subject, with the shared context

overlapCount.description: Number of shared fundraise transactions between the two people

round.description: Round label of the shared fundraise transaction

sharedEntity.description: Entity whose fundraise both people participated in (association projection)

PersonGraphMember.description: Lean person rail member with association title facts

personSlug.description: Canonical lowercase URL slug for the resource

titleName.description: Read-side corporate title text for the association row

EmployeeCount.description: Employee-count time-series point for an entity

asOfDate.description: Date the employee count applies to, preserving the available calendar or timestamp precision.

EntityFundraiseTransactionEntity.description: Entity projection used inside FundraiseTransaction responses

PersonGraphSimilarEntity.description: Similar-entity card with its key people

entity.description: Entity card projection: core identity plus aggregate funding rollup

keyPerson.description: Top-ranked current people at the similar entity

EntityResearchFactValue.description: Canonical typed fact value nested under entity research fields

asOfDate.description: Date the research fact applies to, preserving the source's calendar or timestamp precision.

currentEligible.description: Current-fact eligibility projected from the canonical research detail row.

dateValue.description: Date-valued research fact, preserving the source's year, month, day, or timestamp precision.

decimalValue.description: Lossless monetary decimal string; numericValue is only its legacy approximation. Absent for legacy-only numbers.

measurementBasis.description: Source-stated measurement/accounting basis; null means unknown.

reportingScope.description: Source-stated reporting scope; null means unknown.

EntityValuationDataConfidence.description: Confidence tier for this data point.

EntityResearchValueType.description: Output kind for governed research detail values

EntityPersonAssociationFilter.description: Constraints on one independent entity-person association.

entityFilter.description: Constraints on the associated entity, including its exact names.

isCurrent.description: Filter this association by whether it is current.

PersonListArrayFilter.description: Array and range filters for person list endpoints

typeRecord.description: Associated types; Organization uses EntityFilter expansion.

InvestorActivityFilter.description: Aggregate investor activity filters from distinct fundraise deals and USD amounts.

averageAmountInvestedUsdRange.description: Average USD amount-invested ranges with inclusive bounds.

largestAmountInvestedUsdRange.description: Largest USD amount-invested ranges with inclusive bounds.

smallestAmountInvestedUsdRange.description: Smallest USD amount-invested ranges with inclusive bounds.

totalAmountInvestedUsdRange.description: Total USD amount-invested ranges with inclusive bounds.

totalInvestmentRange.description: Distinct fundraise-deal count ranges for an investor, with inclusive integer bounds.

PersonEnrichment.description: Supplemental person data — addresses and URL links

urlLink.description: External and social URL links associated with the person

entityId.description: Entity whose newly linked public news is delivered.

secret.description: Standard Webhooks signing secret: whsec_ followed by base64 of 24 to 64 bytes. It is never returned. The CLI reads it only from --from-file, never a flag.

url.description: Public https endpoint that receives signed event POSTs.

NewsSubscriptionDeliveryStatus.description: active delivers; retrying backs off after a failure; paused stopped after the maximum consecutive failures until the subscription is refreshed; expired passed refreshBefore and is about to be removed.

NewsAnalysis.description: The current shared, publicly readable article analysis.

NewsAnalysisSection.description: One accepted analysis step and its cited interpretation.

title.description: Title of the accepted catalog step, set by the server at publication.

NewsAnalysisSourceReference.description: A source supporting the analysis: its URL and a verbatim quote from it.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the cited source that supports the section.

sourceDocumentId.description: Stored source document holding the quote, when one was captured.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL of the cited source.

LookupJobMention.description: One company or person a source names, which stored record it is, and, from a standard article job or streaming lookup, the new unpublished record created when it is new. Bulk lookup only identifies names and creates no records.

enrichmentRunId.description: Research request filed for this mention, if any.

entity.description: POST /v1/lookup/mentions only: the candidate companies as search results show them, the match first, then by match probability and duplicate-check score.

failureReason.description: One sentence on why this name could not be identified; absent otherwise.

identification.description: The lookup of this name with the source as its context: MATCHED names the stored record, NEEDS_REVIEW lists the candidates, NO_MATCH means none is stored. Absent when failureReason is set.

mentionType.description: Whether the source names a company, a Product or Service, or a person.

name.description: Name as the source writes it.

person.description: POST /v1/lookup/mentions only: the candidate people as search results show them, ranked like entity.

shell.description: New unpublished record aVenture created, at no charge, for a NO_MATCH name whose own live site names it. enrichmentRunId names research filed for it, if any; to file research yourself, send its entityId to POST /v1/entities/{entityId}/enrichments or its personId to POST /v1/people/{personId}/enrichments.

shellDetail.description: Why no new record was created for this NO_MATCH name.

LookupSourceRead.description: Publisher context and honest reading activity for a shared-article lookup.

continuation.description: A committed durable lookup to follow; only its presence permits a promise to leave and return. Follow its status URL with the same caller's bearer, honoring Retry-After.

message.description: Informational messages to cycle within this stage, never evidence of completed work.

p95Ms.description: Measured reference p95 in milliseconds; no slow-state claim when absent.

LookupSourceReadPhase.description: Observed article-reading activity; unknown future phases retain their supplied copy.

JobState.description: Shared lifecycle states for async jobs (duplicate-check, logo-audit, etc.)

LookupMention.description: One company, Product or Service, or person a caller read from a page or screenshot it did not send.

name.description: Name as the source writes it.

providerName.description: PRODUCT_SERVICE only: the organization that offers it, as the source writes it. When the offering resolves among offerings and its provider settles on an organization record, the match is limited to that record's offerings.

searchQuery.description: Ignored: the lookup searches by name. Still accepted so callers that send it keep working; omit it.

type.description: Whether the source names a company, a Product or Service (PRODUCT_SERVICE), or a person. A Product or Service resolves like a company first, then among Product and Service records when that finds no match, and never creates a new record.

EntityValuationTimeSeriesPoint.description: A single valuation datapoint. `valuationPostMoney` is the canonical charted value; filled when directly recorded or safely derivable from pre-money + amount raised (same currency only). `derivation` explains whether the value was stored or inferred. Only `researchDetail` points have a `detailId` and can be changed here; `fundraiseRound` points are changed through fundraise-round commands.

amountRaised.description: Amount raised in the same currency, only for fundraise rows.

asOfDate.description: Source-stated effective date for this valuation datapoint.

decimalValue.description: Exact source monetary decimal string for a research-detail valuation; legacy Long values are only projections.

declaredBasis.description: Basis declared by the original source.

derivation.description: How pre-money and post-money fields were obtained.

detailId.description: Research detail id for stated valuation rows. Null for fundraise-derived rows, which cannot be updated or deleted on this valuation surface.

label.description: Fundraise round label or legacy detail display text, when present.

source.description: Canonical store that supplied the point.

valuationPostMoney.description: Post-money valuation in full currency units, when known.

valuationPreMoney.description: Pre-money valuation in full currency units, when known.

EntityValuationDerivation.description: How the point's valuationPostMoney and valuationPreMoney were obtained.

EntityUrlCrawlCdnProvider.description: CDN or hosting provider fronting a web URL.

EntityUrlCrawlRenderMode.description: JavaScript rendering requirement for crawl checks.

UniqueIdType.description: External identifier type that maps an owner to a well-known registry id.

ContentCompliance.description: Derived character/word counts and whether the row text meets its governed type contract (word/character limits and paragraph shape). violation lists each unmet rule and is empty when the row is compliant.

characterCount.description: Character count of the row text (UTF-16 units).

meetsRequirements.description: Whether the text satisfies every governed contract rule.

violation.description: One human-readable reason per unmet rule; empty when compliant.

wordCount.description: Word count of the row text (whitespace-separated tokens).

SlugResource.description: Resource type whose slug is being changed

EntitySimilaritySummary.description: Lean similar-entity rail row: core identity, current URL links, funding totals, and similarity provenance. Use EntitySimilarityResult for full EntityList rows.

fundingDetail.description: Funding totals, so similar companies compare without one read each

urlLink.description: Current primary URL links, one per URL type

ResearchDerivedRange.description: Read-only derived range projection for targetDateAbsolute detail rows

asOfDate.description: Observation date from the source detail row

bucket.description: Derived bucket using inclusive 0, 3, 6, 12, and 24 month boundaries

monthsFromNow.description: Whole months from now() to targetDate

targetDate.description: Absolute target date stored for a targetDateAbsolute detail row

ResearchDerivedBucket.description: Bucket computed from now() to the target date with inclusive boundaries at 0, 3, 6, 12, and 24 months

GithubRepo.description: GitHub repository synced for an entity or person from their current github URL links. githubId is GitHub's stable numeric repository id; rows are replaced per owner on each sync, so counts and timestamps reflect the last sync.

githubId.description: GitHub's stable numeric repository id; sync upsert key per owner

homepageUrl.description: Project homepage URL declared on the repository

isArchived.description: True when the repository is archived on GitHub

isFork.description: True when the repository is a fork of another repository

license.description: SPDX license id reported by GitHub

name.description: Repository name (slug segment after the login)

ownerLogin.description: GitHub account login (org or user) the repository belongs to

repoPushedAt.description: GitHub pushed_at of the repository at last sync

url.description: Canonical https GitHub repository page URL

LogoAccuracy.description: Read-only assessment of whether a stored logo/photo depicts the target's own brand, decided from visible features of the stored mark versus the target's own reference marks

candidateObserved.description: Literal visible description of the candidate mark, when assessed by vision

outcome.description: Whether the candidate mark matches the target's own brand

reference.description: Reference marks fetched from the target's own surfaces, each with its perceptual-hash distance to the candidate. The deciding deterministic distance is the smallest entry

referenceObserved.description: Literal visible description of the reference mark, when assessed by vision

sharedFeature.description: The specific visible feature shared by candidate and reference that supports a match (shared name text, symbol, or distinctive palette); null when not a match

MediaObjectType.description: Target domain for media operations (logos, pictures, thumbnails)

LogoAccuracyMethod.description: How a logo-accuracy outcome was reached

LogoAccuracyReference.description: A reference mark from the target's own surface and its distance to the candidate

hammingDistance.description: Perceptual-hash distance between the candidate and this reference

url.description: Direct URL of the reference mark fetched from the target's surface

PersonInvestorParticipation.description: Person investor with round participation labels and count

EntityInvestorParticipation.description: Entity investor with round participation and enrichment data (addresses, URLs)

StageFrequency.description: Canonical equity stage derived from a transaction calculatedRoundLabel, with deal frequency ranked by count descending.

FundraiseFinancialInstrumentType.description: Fundraise financial instrument type — the vehicle a round or investor join used

FundraiseRoundField.description: A funding round field a write asserted that its cited source did not support.

HarnessChassis.description: Agent loop a harness run executes on: the Claude Agent SDK or the Pi agent SDK

HarnessRunLane.description: Queue lane for admission priority: interactive client work vs background backlog

HarnessLlmApi.description: Gateway wire API for a run's LLM calls: Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions, or OpenAI Responses

ResearchAllowanceType.description: Metered allowance. `COMPANY` and `PERSON` meter research runs on company and person-profile targets; `ENTITY_VIEW`, `ENTITY_BRAND`, and `PERSON_VIEW` meter profile and brand reads. Directory exports share `ENTITY_VIEW` for company and investor rows and `PERSON_VIEW` for person rows, once per record per UTC month with detail views; `WEB_SEARCH` meters web searches.

HarnessRunType.description: Research run kind: a caller-filed research request or a narrower scheduled run

EntityTag.description: Classification tag. Catalog and search responses describe the tag itself; entity classification responses also carry classificationId and the entity's current and primary flags.

bucket.description: Canonical classification bucket key; `type` is the value tag search and the catalog accept.

classificationId.description: Id of this classification on the entity; null in catalog and search results.

createdAt.description: Tag creation timestamp, not the time the entity received this tag.

isCurrent.description: In catalog and search results, whether the tag is active; in entity classification responses, whether the classification is current for the entity.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the entity's primary classification in its bucket; null in catalog and search results.

updatedAt.description: Tag update timestamp, not the time the entity's classification changed.

StandardizedClassification.description: Industry or ownership classification from a standard taxonomy such as NAICS, SIC, or ISIC, with its category, code, and hierarchy level.

classificationId.description: Id of this classification on the entity; null in catalog and search results.

code.description: Legacy numeric standardized code when present; does not establish codeText or edition.

codeText.description: Exact source-stated code text; null is unrecorded, never reconstructed from code.

edition.description: Source-stated codebook edition; null is unknown, never an assumed current edition.

isCurrent.description: Standardized reference rows are current by definition.

Sentence boundaries follow Unicode rules (java.text.BreakIterator), so 'Inc.' and 'U.S.' do not split a sentence. EntityFundraiseFilterCriteria.description: Fundraise and investment filters for entity search

amountInvestedRange.description: Investor-level check amounts in the transaction currency, not the round's total raise. Use investedAmountRaisedRange for a named portfolio company's round total. Use plain JSON numbers.

amountRaisedRange.description: Per-round amounts raised by the returned entity itself in USD, not a portfolio company's round total. Use investedAmountRaisedRange for the latter. Use plain JSON numbers.

dateAnnouncedRange.description: Inclusive announcement timestamp bounds on the same fundraise transaction as round and amountRaisedRange. Announcement dates do not establish funding completion dates.

investedAmountRaisedRange.description: Total amounts raised in USD by a named portfolio company's rounds, not an investor's individual check or its own fundraising. Requires nonblank investedCompanyName. Company, investedRound, and this amount match the same portfolio-company transaction.

investedCompanyName.description: Portfolio company brand, legal or canonical names, or a bare domain exactly matching a current WEBSITE root URL (not broad host discovery; no URL paths or queries). A bare-domain miss never falls back to a name. Returns their investors with investedRound, when supplied, bound to the same company transaction regardless of its age.

investedCountry.description: Countries of the companies an investor backed, as country names or ids; a deal matches when its company's current headquarters is in one of them. Restricts returned entities to investors with such a deal inside the investment-activity horizon; the same deal must match investedIndustry and, when investedCompanyName is empty, investedRound.

investedIndustry.description: Industry terms for the companies an investor backed, such as Software, Artificial Intelligence, or Fintech; a term matches a portfolio company whose industry or industry classification name contains it as whole words, case-insensitively. Restricts returned entities to investors with such a deal inside the investment-activity horizon; with investedRound and no investedCompanyName, the same deal must match both.

investedRound.description: Round labels of deals an investor joined, such as Seed or Series A; with investedCompanyName matches those companies' transactions regardless of age, otherwise matches deals inside the investment-activity horizon.

investorName.description: Investor names. Each matches an investor entity whose brand, legal name, or alias equals it ignoring case and punctuation, or an individual investor's exact full name; a name that begins public entities' brands as whole words ("Sequoia") also matches the one holding many times the recorded investments of every other such entity (Sequoia Capital). Restricts returned entities to companies with a fundraise that investor joined.

investorNameMatch.description: How investorName names combine: any (default) returns companies one named investor backed; every returns companies every named investor backed, each in any of the company's fundraises.

lastRoundYearRange.description: Last-round-year ranges for each entity's most recent fundraise round.

rankByInvestmentActivity.description: True ranks returned investors by recent deal activity ahead of any sort: each deal matching investedIndustry, investedCountry, and (when investedCompanyName is empty) investedRound adds a weight that decays to zero over the investment-activity horizon, nudged by the investor's known USD check. Restricts returned entities to investors with such a deal.

round.description: Fundraise round labels, such as Seed or Series A.

totalRaisedRange.description: Total-raised ranges across all rounds in USD. Use plain JSON numbers.

ResearchAccessType.description: What filing one more research run does now. `INCLUDED`: the plan's monthly allowance covers it. `ADDITIONAL_USAGE`: the allowance is spent or withheld, and the run is billed as additional usage (prepaid credit or invoice). `EXHAUSTED`: the plan's allowance is spent and no additional usage can pay for it (off, spend cap reached, or prepaid credit below the unit price); filing answers 429. `PLAN_REQUIRED`: the plan includes no research and no additional usage can pay for it; filing answers 402 or 429. `BILLING_BLOCKED`: a paid plan is past due, unpaid, incomplete, or paused, or an additional-usage invoice is unpaid; filing answers 402.

normalizedUrl.description: Normalized URL match key the lookup resolved against. Null when normalization could not produce a stable key.

url.description: Raw URL the caller queried.

urlType.description: URL type the caller specified, or null if the lookup did not constrain by urlType.

DuplicateCreateReview.description: Candidate-review conflict details returned in ProblemDetail.details for create gates and deterministic lookup ambiguity. The returned candidates are the decision surface: update the matching candidate, create with duplicate override only when every candidate is distinct from the source-backed target, or block when identity is unresolved. score and threshold rank review priority; they are not proof that the requested record is absent.

candidate.description: Entity/person candidates returned by lookup or create duplicate review. If a candidate is the requested record, read/update that candidate by id. Create with duplicate override only after every candidate is reviewed as distinct.

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

newsCandidate.description: News candidates returned by lookup or create duplicate review. If a candidate is the requested article, read/update that article by id. Otherwise block until source evidence proves a distinct article.

overridePath.description: Create endpoint to retry only after reviewing the returned candidates and supplying overrideGate=duplicate and overrideReason as query parameters. Null for detail lookup ambiguity, where the next action is review/update/block.

threshold.description: Review threshold used by duplicate scoring. Scores below this value can still be useful candidate context; this value does not prove absence or authorize create.

ClassificationInactiveTagDetails.description: ProblemDetail.details for HTTP 409 when a classification value exists but is inactive.

availableOverrides.description: Allowed inactiveTagOverride values for this conflict

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

slug.description: Existing dormant value slug or lookup key

NewsSourceUrlConflict.description: Typed extension on ProblemDetail.details for HTTP 409 when a news mutation's publication + newsUrlOriginal pair already belongs to another article. The returned fields identify the existing article so the caller can read/update it instead of creating a duplicate.

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

conflictingArticleId.description: Existing article id (NewsId.value) that already owns this publication + URL pair.

conflictingArticleSlug.description: Existing article slug, or empty string when the existing article has no slug. Use with GET /v1/news/lookup?slug= to fetch the conflicting article.

conflictingArticleTitle.description: Existing article title for human-readable diagnostics.

DomainConflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies which details shape a 409 response carries.

EntityClassificationInactiveTagOverride.description: Caller-chosen handling when the canonical classification value exists but is dormant.

NewsCandidateScore.description: Duplicate candidate scoring result for news articles. Use id/slug/externalId/reason to decide whether the candidate is the requested article. score ranks review priority; it does not prove absence.

externalId.description: Matched external article identifier when duplicate scoring used one.

id.description: News article id to read or update when this candidate is the requested article.

publicationScore.description: Portion of score contributed by the publication match alone; 0 when the publication did not match. A candidate whose score minus publicationScore falls below the review threshold matched only on its outlet, not its story.

reason.description: Match reasons for reviewing the candidate. Exact reasons are decision signals regardless of whether score crosses the review threshold.

score.description: Ranking score for duplicate review. It is not an absence proof; a low score can still be the intended article when reason/slug/externalId match.

slug.description: Candidate article slug from the existing record.

UrlDuplicateJoin.description: Entity or person that currently owns a normalized URL.

owner.description: Owner of the URL: either entityId or personId is populated depending on the owner kind. Use the populated id to read or update the owner's URL.

urlId.description: Identifier of the existing URL record that already holds this address.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per client IP in the current rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left before the tightest applicable rate-limit bucket rejects.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the exhausted rate-limit bucket admits another request; 0 when none is exhausted.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a rate-limited (429) or temporarily unavailable (503) request.
